overlay.label: Search
overlay.error: Search is not available right now. Please try again.
overlay.empty: No results. Try other words or check the spelling.
dashboard.title: Site Search
dashboard.launch_required: Open this dashboard from the Portal.
dashboard.audit_banner: Staff session as {actor}: every action is audited.
dashboard.demo_banner: Demo: sample documents searched in memory. Nothing is stored and nothing can be changed.
dashboard.pick_website: Choose a website in the Portal to open its search dashboard.
dashboard.not_subscribed: This website has no active Site Search subscription with the index element on.
dashboard.engine.title: Search engine
dashboard.atlas.manual: Create this search index in Atlas
dashboard.atlas.help.unknown: The database has not been checked yet; the portable engine answers meanwhile.
dashboard.atlas.help.unavailable: Your database is not on MongoDB Atlas (or Atlas Search is off), so the portable engine answers every search. It runs in your own database with prefix matching, typo tolerance and field boosts.
dashboard.atlas.help.permission_denied: Your database user may not list or create Atlas Search indexes. Grant it the createSearchIndexes and listSearchIndexes actions (for example the Atlas role readWrite plus Atlas Search index management), or create the index below yourself in Atlas → Search. Until then the portable engine answers every search.
dashboard.atlas.help.missing: The search index does not exist yet. It is created automatically when the database user may; the portable engine answers meanwhile.
dashboard.atlas.help.building: Atlas is building the search index. The portable engine answers until it is ready.
dashboard.atlas.help.ready: Searches run on Atlas Search. If Atlas fails, the portable engine answers for a few minutes.
dashboard.atlas.help.failed: Atlas reported a problem with the search index. The portable engine answers every search; check the index in Atlas → Search.
dashboard.atlas.help.disabled: The engine setting is portable: Atlas Search is never used.
dashboard.documents.relaxed: No document matched every word, so documents matching some of them are shown.
dashboard.documents.empty: The index is empty. Turn on Catalog events, add a crawled source or send documents with the API.
dashboard.documents.title: Title
dashboard.sources.intro: Catalog items are indexed from Catalog events; your server can send any document with an sk_ key.
dashboard.sources.none: No crawled sources. Add a JSON feed or a sitemap of your website in the Portal settings.
dashboard.sources.refused.url_not_allowe: not on your website's domain (https only)
dashboard.analytics.disabled: Search analytics is an add-on: switch the analytics element on in the Portal.
dashboard.analytics.privacy: Only daily counts per search text are stored, in your database. No visitor, session or address is kept, and searches that look like e-mail addresses, phone numbers or links are never counted.
dashboard.settings.intro: Settings are managed in the Portal: document types and fields, sources, ranking, suggestions, the overlay and analytics.
